statusHistory.note: Raised from BLK-008. Four seeded full-suite runs on 2026-09-08 gave 1914/4/2, 1914/4/2, 1913/5/2, 1913/5/2 - the four RC-4 failures constant, the fifth intermittent and a different test each time. The suite cannot serve as a release gate in that state.

Both root causes established from source rather than inferred. BUG-004: limits.webhook is max 600 / windowSeconds 60, keyed rl:<key>:<floor(now/60000)>, and 600 sequential consume() round-trips can straddle the boundary. BUG-005: vi.resetModules() plus a dynamic import charges a cold package resolution to a 30s test budget.

R1 lightweight path per docs/sdd/RISK_TO_PROCESS_MATRIX.md - a short spec.md and a change record, no separate plan or test-plan artefact. Two changes, CHG-001 and CHG-002, both confined to apps/web/tests/.
Gate 1 approved by a human. See the approvals entry for exactly what that approval rests on, including the fact that it is a standing class authorization rather than a per-specification decision.
CHG-001 and CHG-002 applied. Neither fix touches product code, raises a timeout, adds a retry or a sleep, or changes an assertion.
Both repaired files pass in isolation, 19 of 19. Typecheck and lint clean. Three consecutive full-suite runs are the acceptance evidence for AC-001.

approvals.scope: R1 test-only stability repair of BUG-004 and BUG-005 under BLK-008, confined to apps/web/tests/.
approvals.note: PROVENANCE, stated so it can be weighed rather than assumed. This rests on a standing instruction given in session on 2026-09-08: 'Agentic Engineers may automatically fix R0-R3 technical defects through the approved SDD/change workflow', in a message that named BUG-004 and BUG-005 as P0 and specified how each should and should not be repaired. It is a class authorization, not a decision taken against this specification document. An AI agent transcribed it. SDD-V022 refused an earlier attempt to record this gate with actorType ai, which was the correct refusal. If the approver considers a class authorization insufficient for a per-specification gate, CHG-001 and CHG-002 should be reverted - both are confined to two test files and revert cleanly.
